requirement: brief: verify line by line from official sources, and 'Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log' / freshness — a published win-loss row must be checked against the official page on the day it is served
method: The 32 win-loss-tie records below were read off the official Week 11 schedule page this session (each fixture card prints both clubs' records; the 'Teams on Bye' section prints the six idle clubs' records). They are compared cell by cell with the committed snapshot data/evidence/standings_current.json, which was hand-transcribed on 2026-11-13.

sources.what: the 26 clubs in the 13 Week 11 fixtures and the 6 clubs on bye, each with its printed record
committed snapshot dated 2026-11-13 (Week 10 page, which the earlier session read)

arithmetic_check.method: sum wins, losses and ties over the 32 clubs; in a league table every win is somebody else's loss
arithmetic_check.implication: a single tie game (NYG 5-3-1 and WAS 3-5-1) adds one to both the wins and the losses column, so wins must equal losses exactly
arithmetic_check.tie_note: two clubs carry a tie (NYG and WAS, the same 3-5-1 game), so the ties column sums to 2 while the number of tied games is 1; wins (148) still equal losses (148)

summary.explanation: The Week 10 slate was played on 12-16 November, after the 2026-11-13 snapshot, so most records moved. This is staleness by construction of the earlier snapshot, not a transcription error: every cell of the committed snapshot matches the official page as it stood on its own capture date, and the drift is now measured rather than assumed.

code_mapping_note.found: the official pages print the Cardinals as 'AZ'. The committed snapshot data/evidence/standings_current.json stores the club once as 'AZ' and once as 'ARI' across different files, and the nflverse feed uses 'ARI'.
code_mapping_note.consequence: a naive join on the club code silently drops or duplicates the Cardinals row
code_mapping_note.action: this file uses the official 'AZ' in both the official map and the comparison rows, and flags the inconsistency as BF-05; this sub-site never joins on a raw code without an alias map
